theme_central: Defense of the Qur'an as the divine Criterion (Furqan) and of the Messenger's authenticity, culminating in the portrait of the "servants of the Most Merciful".
sources_note: Sections 21-40, 41-50 and 63-75 precisely sourced (grokipedia, tafhim al-Qur'an). Rest reconstructed from known landmarks.

branches.title: The Qur'an as Furqan
branches.resume: Objections of the disbelievers refuted: the Prophet eats, walks in the markets like any man.

children.t: Objections refuted: the Prophet eats and walks in the markets like any man

branches.title: Better than their gardens
branches.resume: Promise of gardens better than those demanded, questioning of the idols worshipped at the Judgment.

children.t: Promise of better gardens; questioning of the idols worshipped at the Judgment

branches.title: Parallel prophetic missions
branches.resume: Musa and Pharaoh, Nuh, 'Ad, Thamud, the people of Rass: the same pattern of repeated rejection.

children.t: Musa/Pharaoh, Nuh, 'Ad, Thamud, the people of Rass: repeated rejection of the messengers

branches.title: Contrast between the heedless and the righteous
branches.resume: Mockery of the disbelievers toward the Prophet, cosmological signs: the shadow, the wind, the rain.

children.t: Mockery of the disbelievers, cosmological signs: shadow, wind, rain

branches.title: Sent as a warner, the two seas
branches.resume: The mingling of the two seas (fresh and salt), creation of man from water, the constellations.

children.t: Sent as a warner to all mankind; the mingling of the two seas
Creation from water, the constellations, alternation of day and night

branches.title: The servants of the Most Merciful
branches.resume: Famous portrait of the ibad ar-Rahman: humility, night worship, avoidance of major sins, repentance.

children.t: Humility, night worship, moderation in spending
Not associating partners, not killing, not fornicating; sincere repentance accepted
Avoiding the futile, receptive to reminders, supplication for their offspring
